rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP, but then performed multiple order-changing writes without explicit customer confirmation: it changed the shipping address, swapped a watch item, and initiated an exchange for the air purifier while stating a credit card charge would occur. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before executing. Additionally, the watch item modification appears to target order #W4219264 while the address change targeted #W6729841, creating a risk the wrong order was altered relative to the user’s request for the two-watch order. The agent also did not confirm color availability/preference before swapping to a metal watch. Although the actions might match the user’s intent, the lack of confirmations and potential wrong-order modification violate the stated policy, so the outcome fails the pass bar.
